## Summary
Greet the world by default

## Description
Called without an argument, ./greet.sh prints "Hello, " today. It must print exactly "Hello, World" instead; with an argument it stays "Hello, <name>". Add a check for the no-argument case to ./check.sh, which must keep passing.

## Acceptance criteria
Not present in the ticket record.

## Comments
Not present in the ticket record.

- decision: `${1:-World}` over `${1-World}` — an empty argument ("") greets World too rather than printing "Hello, ".
- decision: README left unchanged — ticket does not ask for it.
- fact: `./check.sh` is the whole suite; new check verified RED (`greet.sh: wrong default greeting`, exit 1) before the fix.
- test: `./check.sh`
- next-model: haiku
